function: Excluded (system): the over-the-air FL link has a scalar LoS channel, a real denoising factor and no RIS, so single antenna at both ends (pp. 3-4).
notes: Over-the-air asynchronous FL with a UAV as parameter server (arXiv:2403.06653v1, Zhai et al.). It passes no_learning through the FL-over-the-air rule: the learned element is the CNN trained with FL on MNIST (p. 8). Device selection, UAV trajectory and transmit gains come from geometric programming and successive convex approximation (pp. 6-8), not from learning. Area would be 7, which wins over 6. The link is a scalar LoS gain, p. 3: "we focus on the line-of-sight (LoS) channels for the connection links", Eq. (7), with a real scalar denoising factor (p. 4), so both ends are single antenna and there is no RIS; the paper never says antenna for its own link. For the reviewer: if the UAV link were read as area 6 (NTN admits single antenna), the exclusion by system would not apply.
